Terrain1 is a planar terrain with vertical displacement made from octaves of Perlin or Simplex noise.
Octaves add copies of the basic pattern with different frequencies and amounts.
Blend mixes between the sum and maximum of octaves.
Aspect lets you change the aspect ratio of octaves, especially useful with rotation.
Detail sets whether the roughness is constant or reducing at higher octaves.

Distort uses summed octaves of Perlin or Simplex vector noise to warp the shape in 3D.
The Align octaves option favors octaves that point in the same direction.
Peak Mix blends in exaggerated peaks.
Detail sets whether the roughness is constant or reducing at higher octaves.
Direction limits displacement directions.

Blend mixes between the sum and maximum of octaves.
Detail sets whether the roughness is constant or reducing at higher octaves.
Direction limits displacement directions.
Random Seed chooses different random terrains.

Flatten squares off the tops of ripples.
Random Seed changes the random aspects.
